sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Purpose The Interaction Record Enrichment (IRE) tool serves as the authoritative data consolidator. Its primary function is to maintain a unified "Source of Truth" by programmatically integrating extracted email context and document intelligence directly into the master conversation log.
Inputs Primary Interaction Record: The foundational record governing the user engagement.
Consolidated Work Notes: The structured, technical output derived from the contextual analysis phase, representing high-fidelity summaries of documents and previous communications.
Contextual Target Target Object: The existing Interaction Record. The IRE tool performs a stateful update to this object, ensuring all downstream agents have immediate access to the enriched data set.
Action & Logic Seamless Record Injection: The tool executes a direct append or embed of the structured email context into the Interaction Record’s system notes.
Holistic Data Packaging: By synthesizing fragmented inputs—such as raw email bodies and technical document insights—the tool creates a comprehensive audit trail. This eliminates data silos and ensures the record is operationally "complete" for the next phase of the workflow.
Key Output Enriched Interaction Record: A finalized, high-context data package. This record now serves as the validated input for subsequent automated analysis, quality review, and final processing.
